<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Driving Rain](/Feats.aspx?ID=4272) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 32

</column>

---

Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision. Each creature in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. Until the start of your next turn, all creatures are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) while in the area, and all creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures within it.

---
**Level (+2)** The damage increases by 1d8.
name: Driving Rain
